messages:
Emma L: Hey everyone — scheduling a short kickoff for Pelago onboarding on Fri 2026-03-27 10:00 PT. Primary goals: API integration, embeddings pipeline, SSO + basic RBAC. Can folks confirm availability and owners? :calendar:
Ravi K: I can own API integration (deveng). Will validate throughput & put together an initial prompt set. Friday works for me.
Jordan M: I'll take SSO and RBAC with infra. Quick ask: need Pelago Okta admin contact and whether they require SCIM provisioning.
Talia (Pelago): hi all, Talia here — yep that's me, confirmed 10am PT. We do want SCIM eventually, initial sync can be SAML SSO + invite flow. I'll bring our Okta admin and data owner.
Sophie CSM: I'll own success criteria + stakeholder comms. Proposing top-level success criteria: 1) API integration end-to-end, 2) 50 prompt tests w/ perf targets, 3) SSO working and audit logs in place, 4) basic cost guardrails documented.
Ravi K: For perf targets, can we aim p50 gen < 200ms for short prompts and batch throughput >= 10 req/s on a Dedicated profile? Need benchmark numbers from runtime team.
Jordan M: Those targets depend on model choice. If they want a larger model we'll suggest fallback to a quantized smaller variant. I'll draft fallback routing policy.
Emma L: Action items summary: Ravi = API + sample prompts + perf bench; Jordan = SSO + routing/fallback + infra checklist; Sophie = final success criteria doc + stakeholder comms; Talia = grant access, send sample dataset and Okta test tenant. I'll create the tracking board and PR template.
onboard-bot: New onboarding board created: https://redwood.in/boards/PLG-6789
Ravi K: Also flagged renewal risk in notes — Pelago is cost-sensitive and flagged possible budget cuts in Q3. We should include unit-cost forecast and Optimize recommendations early.
Talia (Pelago): good call — budget constrained through Q3, so quantization and batching suggestions would be very helpful.
Sophie CSM: Adding "cost guardrails" to the success criteria. We'll prepare a short runbook with quantization recommendations, batching config, and expected unit-cost ranges.
Jordan M: Can we add a staging dry-run deploy next Wed (2026-04-01)? Prefer to validate KV cache behavior and prefix caching with the sample prompts.
Emma L: Yes — propose milestones: Week 1 (by 4/3): auth + API smoke + data access; Week 2: prompt eval + perf tuning; Week 3: staging dry run + rollout plan; Week 4: go-live checklist and post-launch monitoring.
Ravi K: Looks good. I'll post the initial prompt set and perf scripts by Monday EOD.
Talia (Pelago): I'll share the dataset and invite Okta test admins by Monday as well.
Sophie CSM: I'll schedule a weekly 30-min sync (Tues 9am PT) starting next week and send calendar invites.
Emma L: If no objections I'll lock the calendar, send pre-read (cost model + success criteria + access steps), and add the eval harness to the board for quality monitoring.
Jordan M: :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Meeting created 2026-03-27 10:00 PT — attendees Emma L, Ravi K, Jordan M, Sophie CSM, Talia (Pelago)
Emma L: Thanks all — small note: include a lightweight eval harness so we can detect quality regressions when we tweak quantization or model variants. I'll add that to the board as a discrete ticket.
